response.content: {"critique": "The problem is that users cannot save or lock custom filters on the claims list. I checked the five most similar items: Workspace administration (4131), Document classifier confidence threshold (4133), Claims timeline roadmap page, Bulk upload documents (4127), and Claim search refinements (4128). No shipped story or roadmap item solves the same core problem.", "verdict": "pass"}
